annotations.title: Counts and medians by one grouping (50 groups, 8 s)

description:
Counts and medians by ONE grouping over the same query search_assets would
    run: "homes by local authority", "land parcels by use". `measures` is up to
    3 names (default count; e.g. median(price)); group_by and measures come from
    search_capabilities. Returns at most 50 groups.

    Do NOT use it for a list of records (use search_assets) or for a value of a
    property. It has an 8 second limit: past it the call answers covered=false with
    that reason, so narrow the place or add a criterion and ask again.
    Free.

    `place` is exactly one of {uprn}, {postcode}, {area: {type, code}} or {geometry} (point + radius_m up to 2000, bbox up to 5 km, polygon up to 200 vertices); free text is refused, call resolve_place first.
    UK only. Limits: at most 50 groups, 3 measures, 12 criteria, 8 s, 8 KB.
    A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged.

PlaceArg.description: Exactly one of uprn, postcode, area, geometry. Free text is refused: call resolve_place first.
